citationText: Wolf S. K. Sette J. W. : “Progress in the Acoustics of Sound Recording and Reproduction for Motion Pictures,” Rev. Sci. Instr. , VII (Sept., 1936 ), No. 9 , p. 323 . Note that the decibel ratings mentioned in these papers are referred to the threshold of audibility. The new sound-level meters use 10–16 watts per sq. cm. as reference level. Accordingly, for any given sound a new standard sound-level meter will read approximately 7 db. higher than if the measurement were referred to the threshold of audibility.
